name: Pristine Line-of-Sight
description: Clear line of sight, minimal contention, optimal link operation.
ground_truth_root_cause: Nominal channel with strong signal margin.

name: Standard Indoor Office Link
description: Typical indoor attenuation through drywall, within normal tolerance.
ground_truth_root_cause: Normal propagation with minor background absorption.

name: Quiet Baseline Network
description: Quiescent mesh state, low packet transmission rate, excellent delivery.
ground_truth_root_cause: Optimal radio operating parameters.

name: Stable Edge Coverage
description: Moderate signal at room perimeter but stable SNR and negligible loss.
ground_truth_root_cause: Distance path loss without multipath or destructive interference.

name: Suburban Low-Interference Link
description: Sparse RF neighborhood, low noise floor, clean spectrum.
ground_truth_root_cause: Clean spectrum with zero co-channel interferers.

name: Rain Attenuation & Multipath
description: Atmospheric absorption and wet surface reflections degrading signal.
ground_truth_root_cause: Multipath reflections and rain fade causing signal dispersion.

name: Warehouse Metal Shelf Reflection
description: Inter-symbol interference from steel racking reflections.
ground_truth_root_cause: Severe multipath delay spread resolved by antenna diversity.

name: Dynamic Human Body Shadowing
description: Transient pedestrian movement intermittently blocking line of sight.
ground_truth_root_cause: Shadow fading and diffraction around obstacles.

name: Antenna Polarization Drift
description: Tilted transmitter node causing cross-polarization signal attenuation.
ground_truth_root_cause: Antenna polarization mismatch requiring diversity switch.

name: High Density WiFi Contention
description: Clear Channel Assessment busy 82% due to neighboring AP beacon floods.
ground_truth_root_cause: Excessive CCA medium occupancy from co-channel transmissions.

name: Neighboring High-Throughput Stream
description: Adjacent device saturation consuming 78% of airtime.
ground_truth_root_cause: Airtime exhaustion causing CSMA backoff delay.

name: Mesh Beacon Collision Cluster
description: Periodic broadcast collisions during synchronized mesh heartbeats.
ground_truth_root_cause: Synchronized burst collisions elevating frame retries.

name: Perimeter Gatehouse Link
description: Node deployed near reception boundary with -86 dBm RSSI.
ground_truth_root_cause: Free-space path loss approaching receiver sensitivity limit.

name: Tree Canopy Wet Leaf Fade
description: Green vegetation absorption adding 10dB loss after rainstorm.
ground_truth_root_cause: Dielectric absorption from foliage water content.

name: Excessive Queue Bufferbloat
description: Upstream switch buffer overflow creating 85ms packet transit jitter.
ground_truth_root_cause: Network queuing latency variance without RF degradation.

name: MAC Queue Congestion Spike
description: Transit queue delay spike (75ms jitter) with moderate retries.
ground_truth_root_cause: Link buffer congestion elevating packet inter-arrival latency.

name: Microwave Oven / Continuous 2.4GHz Jam
description: Severe unmodulated in-band emissions destroying packets (78% PER).
ground_truth_root_cause: Continuous RF radiation destroying SNR, forcing immediate channel hop.

name: Co-Channel Transmitter Overlap
description: Uncoordinated high-power base station turned on on Channel 6.
ground_truth_root_cause: Co-channel interference collapse requiring channel failover.

name: Structural RF Shadow Blackout
description: Fire door closed across link corridor, cutting signal to -97 dBm.
ground_truth_root_cause: Severe structural penetration loss causing total link disconnect.

name: Exhausted ACK Retry Threshold
description: Consecutive transmission attempts failed; PER at 82%.
ground_truth_root_cause: Physical disconnect; MAC layer ACK timeout limit exceeded.

name: High Signal with Severe Packet Loss
description: RSSI is strong (-55 dBm) but PER is 75% due to non-WiFi jamming pulse.
ground_truth_root_cause: In-band pulsed jammer saturating receiver despite strong carrier.

name: Weak Signal with Clean Delivery
description: RSSI is low (-87 dBm) but packet error rate is only 2% with 0 retries.
ground_truth_root_cause: Fringe link operating near sensitivity threshold, needs monitoring.

name: Zero Loss with Severe Queue Jitter
description: All packets arrive intact, but delay variance hits 110ms.
ground_truth_root_cause: Critical transit jitter exceeding 90ms NOUL invariant.

name: High CCA Occupancy with Zero Retries
description: Channel busy is 89% from foreign network, but mesh packets slip through.
ground_truth_root_cause: Channel occupancy exceeds 88% critical ceiling, risking lockup.

name: Borderline Threshold Transition
description: RSSI sits at exactly -78.5 dBm, PER at 14.8%, 3 retries.
ground_truth_root_cause: Telemetry straddling normal/degraded threshold boundary.

name: Borderline Critical Precipice
description: RSSI -87.8 dBm, PER 39.2%, 6 retries, 88ms jitter.
ground_truth_root_cause: Marginal degraded link on the verge of critical collapse.

name: Spurious Transient CRC Glitch
description: Single corrupted burst causing 16% PER on otherwise clean link.
ground_truth_root_cause: Transient burst noise tripping degradation threshold.

name: Local Industrial Noise Floor Elevation
description: Motor brush sparking raises floor; RSSI -68 dBm, SNR drops to 9 dB.
ground_truth_root_cause: Elevated noise floor reducing effective SNR margin.

name: Telemetry Ingestion Noise - Jitter Jumps
description: Stochastic timing measurement jitter fluctuation (+-15ms).
ground_truth_root_cause: Degraded multipath link with noisy timer measurement.

name: Fast Rayleigh Fading Fluctuation
description: Rapid RSSI fluctuations (-76 to -84 dBm) due to moving fan blades.
ground_truth_root_cause: Fast Rayleigh fading causing signal variance.

name: Post-Storm Channel Clearing
description: Wet surfaces drying, RSSI improving from -84 to -68 dBm.
ground_truth_root_cause: Natural recovery of propagation path; normal pacing restored.

name: Stabilization on Alternate Channel
description: Mesh relocated to Channel 11; contention dropped from 94% to 18%.
ground_truth_root_cause: Successful channel migration restoring full link health.

name: Diversity Antenna Alignment Verification
description: Post-switch verification; RSSI climbed from -83 to -66 dBm.
ground_truth_root_cause: Antenna diversity successfully circumvented multipath null.

name: Frequency-Selective Notch Fade
description: Destructive reflection cancellation creating narrow null on carrier.
ground_truth_root_cause: Frequency selective null resolved by space/polarization diversity.

name: Coaxial Feedline Detachment
description: Physical RF cable loosened, signal plunges to -98 dBm.
ground_truth_root_cause: Hardware transceiver feedline disconnect or catastrophic path loss.

name: Rogue Node Broadcast Flood
description: Malfunctioning sensor spamming raw frames, jamming channel.
ground_truth_root_cause: Denial of service collision storm requiring frequency change.

name: Temperature Oscillator Frequency Drift
description: Night cooling causing 50kHz crystal drift, elevating retries to 3.
ground_truth_root_cause: Carrier frequency offset degradation near decision boundary.

name: Ultra-Low Power Proximity Link
description: Nodes 1 meter apart running at -15dBm TX power for energy saving.
ground_truth_root_cause: Short-range energy-conserved link operating at peak margin.

name: Fringe Range with Active Interference
description: Weak signal (-91 dBm) plus industrial jammer pushes PER to 84%.
ground_truth_root_cause: Compound failure: weak link overwhelmed by external interference.

name: Bluetooth LE Coexistence Bursts
description: Onboard Bluetooth LE advertising bursts causing occasional packet collisions.
ground_truth_root_cause: Collocated 2.4GHz Bluetooth coexistence interference.

name: Hidden Node Collision Bursts
description: High signal strength (-59 dBm) but elevated PER and retries due to non-sensing collision stations.
ground_truth_root_cause: Hidden terminal problem creating MAC collision retries despite high RSSI.

name: Beamformed Perimeter Link
description: Fringe attenuation (-84 dBm) but zero packet loss due to directional spatial beamforming.
ground_truth_root_cause: Beamforming antenna gain sustains packet delivery despite nominal path loss.

name: 2.45 GHz Magnetron RF Bleed
description: Industrial microwave radiation raises noise floor to -71 dBm, collapsing link SNR.
ground_truth_root_cause: Unmodulated non-Wi-Fi radiation source swamping receiver front-end.

name: Queuing Delay Spike (Bufferbloat)
description: Clean physical link but upstream switch queue bloat creates 125ms transit jitter.
ground_truth_root_cause: Network layer buffer exhaustion inducing extreme transit delay variance.

name: Coaxial Antenna Feedline Severed
description: Direct RF feed break causes 50 dB signal drop to noise floor with 98% packet loss.
ground_truth_root_cause: Physical RF path disconnect requiring immediate failover to alternate interface.

name: Heavy Rain on Forest Canopy
description: Wet foliage introduces 12 dB excess attenuation and moderate multipath scattering.
ground_truth_root_cause: Water absorption resonance at 2.4GHz creating dynamic attenuation.

name: Marginal Baseline Operating State
description: Operating parameters close to degradation line but packet delivery remains within spec.
ground_truth_root_cause: Sub-threshold signal variation not requiring hardware actuation.

name: Razor-Edge Degrading Boundary
description: Telemetry hovering directly on the border between degrading and critical.
ground_truth_root_cause: Boundary condition appropriately handled by antenna diversity before catastrophic drop.

name: Continuous Wave RF Carrier Jammer
description: Massive narrowband carrier overwhelms receiver ADC; RSSI looks strong but SNR is -4 dB.
ground_truth_root_cause: Intentional continuous-wave jamming saturating RF front-end.

name: Adjacent Channel Power Spillover
description: Heavy transmission on adjacent channel 5 leaks spectral mask into channel 6.
ground_truth_root_cause: Spectral mask spillover from uncoordinated adjacent-channel neighbor.

name: Asymmetric Uplink/Downlink Fade
description: Downlink beacon is audible (-79 dBm) but uplink ACK packets drop due to remote noise.
ground_truth_root_cause: Asymmetric interference field at remote node causing ACK drop.

name: Deep Multipath Destructive Null
description: Two reflections arrive 180 degrees out of phase, creating a standing-wave null.
ground_truth_root_cause: Complete RF carrier cancellation from indoor metallic reflection.
